quotes.text: QB01. “LA SCORSA SETTIMANA” “NOME” ha svolto almeno un’ora di lavoro da cui ha ricavato o ricaverà un guadagno?

QC18 Nello svolgimento del suo lavoro “NOME” utilizza strumenti/strutture di sua proprietà o di proprietà del suo principale cliente/committente (ad esempio computer o macchinari, locali per la vendita, uffici)?
QC29 Per quale tra questi motivi lavora part time:
QC32 “NOME” di solito quante ore lavora a settimana? Indichi anche frazioni di ore (ed escluda l’interruzione per i pasti e gli spostamenti casa lavoro)..
QC45 (HOC1_2019) Di solito “NOME” in che modo decide l'orario di inizio e di fine della sua giornata lavorativa?

assessments.reasoning: The survey does not capture intra-household dimensions separately at the individual member level as defined: 1) Economic maintenance: QB01 asks whether a member worked for pay or gain, but the instrument does not collect income or support amounts by member across all sources (wages, pensions, remittances, etc.). 2) Labor burden: QC32 collects weekly hours spent in paid work, and QC29 records caregiving/housework as reasons for part-time work, but no module collects time or hours spent on unpaid domestic or care work. 3) Property and asset control: QC18 asks whether work tools used in the respondent's main job are self-owned or provided by clients, but the questionnaire does not collect individual ownership of household assets, land, or dwelling tenure. 4) Decision-making: QC45 measures individual schedule autonomy at work, but the questionnaire contains no items regarding household decision-making power across spheres such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices.
